ownership.pool: Strong intrusive roster of admitted lifetime scopes
ownership.instance: Strong intrusive roster of admitted payload scopes
ownership.payload: Strong intrusive roster of page roots and primary writer handles
ownership.page: Strong intrusive roster of captured reader handles; fixed array remains owned until the final handle retires
ownership.consumer: A live reader must be registered with an exact retained consumer owner before exposure; producer retention alone is not consumer adoption

transitions.guard: Exact active payload; safe integer length 1..256; shared byte, page and handle capacity available
transitions.effect: Atomically charge 256 bytes, one page root and one writer handle before allocation

transitions.guard: Exact retained reservation; active admission; work grant covers 256 bytes
transitions.effect: Allocate only one fixed 256-byte array; refusal retains the reservation

transitions.guard: Sequential initialized prefix, byte in 0..255 and one-byte work grant
Initialized prefix equals declared logical page length
Active admission and shared handle capacity; live exposure also requires exact consumer registration
transitions.effect: Retain an immutable read handle without releasing byte or page charge

transitions.guard: Exact retained owner; activation may already be revoked
transitions.effect: Stop new allocation, writes and captures; preserve already issued reader bytes

transitions.guard: Exact strong parent roster or writer handle
transitions.effect: Recover an abandoned writer through bounded retirement, without invalidating independent read aliases

transitions.guard: All exact handles retired; array scrubbed and detached; separate metadata-release step admitted
transitions.effect: Unlink the page and return its byte/page/handle reservation once
